task.description:
Produce design artefacts for PRM-02, PRM-03, PRM-04, PRM-05 (Stage 16 MUST, VALIDATED) on branch feature/WF02-prm-batch2-20260814.

BRANCH: feature/WF02-prm-batch2-20260814 (base: origin/main 05be8706)

REQUIREMENTS SUMMARY:

PRM-02: Conflict pre-flight rejection
  - Run conflict detection as first step of promotion pipeline, before any transaction opens
  - Conflict condition: target tenant active version of process_key > base_version source branched from
  - On conflict: return typed ConflictRejection naming each conflicting definition with source/target change
  - Append exactly one DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED event in its own transaction
  - Move to FAILED state

PRM-03: Plan digest binds approval to a diff
  - SHA-256 digest (lowercase hex) over canonical JSON of promotion plan
  - Canonical = object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace
  - Entry shape: {type, id, change_kind, before, after} — NOTE: previously {type,id,changes} was flagged as conflict with RELEASED PRM-01, fixed to match
  - Digest + full serialised plan stored on promotion_reviews row at submit time
  - Approve and apply both require digest in request body; mismatch = HTTP 409 PlanDigestMismatch

PRM-04: Promotion review state machine
  - Table: promotion_reviews (id, tenant_id, plan_digest, def_type, def_id, serialised_plan, status, requested_by, approved_by, approved_at, superseded_by, row_version, created_at, updated_at)
  - Status CHECK: pending_review, approved, rejected, applied, failed, superseded
  - Permitted edges (7):
    pending_review -> approved
    pending_review -> rejected
    approved -> applied
    approved -> failed
    applied -> superseded
    failed -> superseded
    rejected -> superseded (NEW — added to fix BLOCKER vs RELEASED PRM-08)

PRM-05: Non-skippable human approval gate
  - No bypass parameter/header/flag/config
  - requested_by principal cannot approve its own review
  - GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context returns: stored plan, artifact assertions, NEEDS_REVIEW package, plan_digest
  - NEEDS_REVIEW package is defined (per PRM-05 body: a structured set of rules/criteria that require human review)

EXISTING CODE TO LEVERAGE:
- src/definition/promotion.zig (existing promotion pipeline)
- src/definition/rollback.zig (rollback state machine — pattern to follow)
- src/promotion/store.zig or src/promotion/*.zig (promotion data access)
- src/promotion/routes.zig (existing promotion API routes)
- src/auth/identity.zig (TENANT_CONTEXT extraction)
- docs/processes/system/definition-promotion.md (process doc with state machine diagram)
- docs/BPM_Platform_Backend_Architecture.md (existing patterns)

DESIGN ARTEFACTS TO PRODUCE (write to src/design/):
1. prm-02-conflict-preflight-design.md — describe conflict detection logic, the pre-flight check, ConflictRejection type, event appending
2. prm-03-plan-digest-design.md — describe SHA-256 digest computation, canonical JSON rules, storage on promotion_reviews, digest validation in Approve/Apply
3. prm-04-promotion-review-sm-design.md — describe the promotion_reviews table schema, status CHECK constraint, 7-edge state machine, superseded_by logic, row_version
4. prm-05-needs-review-gate-design.md — describe the non-skippable gate, self-approval prevention, GET /context endpoint

Each design file must:
- Define all new/modified interfaces, types, and function signatures
- Describe data flow for the feature
- Reference existing code that will be extended
- Include acceptance criteria mapping to the requirement's AC
- Have no implementation code

Return PASS with list of created artefact files in result.artifacts_out.
